event_impacts.event_summary: Italy North flat glass plant restart: Float line ignited March 4, 2026; +25M EUR EBITDA contribution estimate
event_impacts.quantification_notes: Company disclosed estimate: +25M EUR EBITDA contribution. TRY equivalent: 25M × 52.10 EUR/TRY = 1.30B TRY. Materiality: +12.0% vs 2024 EBITDA (10.82B TRY). Net Debt/EBITDA improvement: 8.88× → 7.93× (with Italy +1.30B EBITDA). Timing: Q2 2026 ramp-up, H2 2026 full run-rate; FY2026E contribution ≈ 18.75M EUR (9 months). FX risk: EUR earnings subject to EUR/TRY volatility (currently 52.10).
secondary_effects: Working capital impact: Restart requires raw material inventory buildup, receivables from new sales (NWC increase in Q2 2026)
CAPEX for restart: Cold repair likely already incurred in 2025 (cash impact historical)
Strategic signal: Productivity Management Program is working; validates operational efficiency strategy
risks: Ramp-up execution: Plant may not reach full utilization immediately; mechanical risks post-restart
Demand risk: +25M EUR assumes demand absorption; if European flat glass demand weak (≈1% growth), capacity may underutilize
EUR/TRY volatility: TRY contribution varies with FX (currently 52.10, historically volatile)
Cost inflation: Energy costs in Italy remain elevated; natural gas price spikes compress margin
warnings: EBITDA estimate is management guidance — not audited, execution risk remains
Full contribution only in H2 2026 (6+ months out)
Demand dependency: Europe flat glass demand weak per sector analysis
FX exposure: EUR earnings converted to TRY creates volatility

event_impacts.event_summary: Denizli glassware production transfer to Kırklareli: Hand-made + automatic capacity consolidation for logistics/productivity
event_impacts.quantification_notes: No cost or benefit estimates disclosed. Industry benchmark speculation (NOT company guidance): (1) One-time relocation cost: 5-10% of segment revenue ≈ 2.3B TRY if glassware ≈18% of total revenue. (2) Annual savings: 3-7% OPEX reduction ≈ 1.65B TRY medium-term. Materiality (speculative): 2.3B TRY one-time = 21% of 2024 EBITDA; 1.65B TRY annual = 15% of EBITDA. Expected completion: Q4 2026 or Q1 2027 (12-18 months from June 2025 announcement). Benefit realization: 2027.
secondary_effects: Employment impact: Denizli workforce transfer or severance; Kırklareli hiring/training
Asset impairment risk: If Denizli facility closed/sold, potential write-down
Production continuity risk: Transfer execution may disrupt glassware segment output (temporary revenue dip)
Strategic signal: Part of Productivity Management Program; management prioritizing Europe export competitiveness (Kırklareli location)
risks: Execution complexity: Moving skilled artisan production (hand-made glassware) is higher risk than automated lines
Cost overrun: Plant relocations frequently exceed budget (industry norm: 20-30% overrun)
Customer disruption: Production gaps can damage customer relationships
Labor relations: Potential union or employee resistance in Denizli
warnings: NOT QUANTIFIABLE — no company estimates disclosed for cost or savings
SPECULATIVE ESTIMATES ONLY — industry benchmarks applied, not SISE-specific
Execution status unknown — 9 months since announcement, no update in outputs
Segment financials missing — glassware revenue/margin breakdown needed for precision
